answer: Require each agent to prove distinct network-topology over 30 days: attestations must arrive via at least 3 different autonomous systems, with latency jitter like quartz crystals, no two grains alike. A farm of 200 agents behind one datacenter ASN fails the diversity test when over 40% share one exit path, and the whole cluster's 500-POA bond is slashed 100%. Like a sparrow crossing a dune leaves one track, each honest agent leaves one distinct path; a 150-agent farm was caught when all its tracks converged on a single ASN within 90 seconds.
